messages:
aisha_cs: Quick heads-up — ACME pilot has a latency SLO variance on the embeddings route this morning. p95 ~410ms (target 300ms), availability 99.91% (target 99.95%). Renewal check-in in ~6 weeks, customer mentioned this on last call. Need CS + Eng + Sales triage and a comms/playbook before renewal outreach.

tom_eng: Looking into traces now. My first suspicion is batching/config and a handful of cold-paths during bursty traffic. Will run a narrow query to confirm.

ops_bot: Incident note: latency_slo_embeddings p95=410ms over 1d window — dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/embeddings/slo-embeddings

jon_sales: Saw this flagged in the renewal prep doc. Customer is sensitive to latency for their search flow; if we can't show a plan, renewal risk goes up. Do we want to offer a temporary credit while we fix?

lina_cs_manager: Proposed playbook: 1) Eng triage + quick mitigation (owner: tom_eng), 2) CS drafts comms + collects customer feedback and usage (owner: aisha_cs), 3) Ops posts pre/post metrics and evidence, 4) Sales keeps renewal messaging aligned (owner: jon_sales). If breach confirmed, offer goodwill credit and document in account notes.

aisha_cs: Captured customer feedback: they want an explicit p95 commitment and a clear remediation timeline. I can draft the comms once Eng confirms root cause. @tom_eng can you estimate ETA for a fix? EOD tomorrow preferred.

tom_eng: If it's config we can patch and rollout canary in a few hours. If it requires a model variant or infra change, might be 48–72h. Quick query I'm running now:
```
# check spike sources by region/service
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embeddings",le="0.5"}[1h])) by (region)
```
I'll follow up with traces and a short PR if it's config.

ops_bot: Snapshot attached: p95 trend + error rate trend (last 72h) — https://grafana.internal.redwood/explore?panelId=24

jon_sales: For credits: prefer a one-off goodwill credit vs changing contract terms during a pilot. CS can propose a dollar amount; finance approval needed for >$X. Aisha, can you estimate monthly spend for this customer?

aisha_cs: Sent usage and billing snapshot to the thread (link to internal doc). For this pilot month they're at ~$3.2k usage.

lina_cs_manager: Credit guidance (internal): availability drop to 99.9–99.95% = standard credit tier 5% of monthly usage; below 99.9% = 10%. We'll finalize after Ops confirms the window and root cause.

tom_eng: Quick finding: ~30% of embedding requests were hitting a cold-path during burst windows — increased latency spikes correlated with concurrent cache misses. Short-term mitigation: increase pre-warm and reduce batch max_size from 64->32. I'll open a PR and can canary it.

tom_eng: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/pull/2768 — includes batching tweak + pre-warm heuristic. Requesting review, tagging @eng-oncall.

aisha_cs: Thanks. I'll hold drafting customer comms until we have post-canary metrics. If the canary looks good, we'll propose a goodwill credit per Lina's guidance and present that in the renewal pack as a remediation note.

jon_sales: Perfect. Once CS has the comms draft, send me a copy so I can align renewal messaging. If we need to show a timeline in the renewal deck, we'll want a measurable target and the canary results.

lina_cs_manager: I'll schedule a triage tomorrow 10:00am PT with Eng + CS + Sales to review canary results and finalize comms. Action owners: tom_eng (PR + fix), ops_bot (post-change metrics), aisha_cs (comms + customer feedback), jon_sales (renewal messaging).

ops_bot: Calendar invite created: Triaged SLO variance — 2768000700 — https://cal.internal.redwood/event/2768

jon_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:

aisha_cs: Adding this to the account health doc and renewal risk tracker. Will post customer-facing comms draft here after triage.

tom_eng: Will update thread after canary metrics are in. ETA: canary by tomorrow 11:30am PT.

lina_cs_manager: Great — thanks team.
